== Notes ==
*The [[AI]] maintains this skill out of combat. It doesn't move to the foe to drop the item, but rather waits for the foe to come. The AI also drops this item on any foe regardless of whether the foe is blinded or not nor whether it is a [[physical attacker]] or [[spellcaster]].

== Trivia ==
